scopeChangeReason: THIRD EXPANSION driven by REVIEW round 4 finding B-70a6:F-005 (high, lattice-review-behavior, independently corroborated by lattice-review-test-coverage). The F-004 fix established reconcilePendingReopenAudit at the top of runStoryTransitionInner, but the invariant 'no phase change can follow an unaudited reopen' is NOT framework-wide: story_discard (packages/main/src/handlers/worktree.ts:1428) and the zombie-story DONE-reconcile path (packages/main/src/handlers/story-query.ts:796) both mutate story.phase directly via store.writeStory without reconciling. Proven empirically in an isolated scratch repo: crash-inject the reopen audit append, then story_discard --force deletes the worktree and branch that held the pending record, the story reaches terminal DISCARDED with zero warning, and the audit event is PERMANENTLY lost - falsifying the implementer's documented residual #2 that recovery is merely deferred. Adding exactly one file, packages/main/src/handlers/story-query.ts, so the reconcile can be invoked at both out-of-band phase-mutation sites. machine.ts, version-bump.ts and process-events.ts remain protected.

acknowledgements.reason: Lifecycle artifact written by the independent lattice-review-story-init reviewer during the INIT gate, not a code change and not scope creep. It has no runtime registry entry so the fail-closed unknown-path rule flags it, but the story contract deliberately declares only material source paths; acknowledging rather than widening allowedModify keeps the contract precise about which CODE may change.
